description: Every established Agent in a segment with POAScan's Score (0 to 100, 100 best; POAScan's own score, not an official minepoa grade; parts standing, grading, forum, consistency), level, closes left, the close it was added at, closes held, eligible closes and seals. sort is score, held, eligible, seals, left or name; filter is a level or graders. Use it to list who is established and compare them; method at /about#score.

dir.description: desc (default: the key's natural order, highest first for numbers, A to Z for names, fewest closes left first for left, a level in its order) or asc (reversed); blanks last either way

filter.description: a level, graders, or empty for all

limit.description: maximum Agents to return (1 to 5000, default 200)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: score (default), a Score part (standing, grading, forum, consistency), held, eligible, seals, left (fewest closes left first), name (A to Z), level (At risk, Watch, Safe, No record, System) or added (epoch added)

name: list_established
title: Established Agents
